whenToUse: A streetwear or limited-edition brand selling in timed drops with stock counts.
Shops built around a countdown, reminders and quick-add sizes.
avoidWhen: Evergreen catalogues without drops — use site-store-01.
a11y: Stock and countdown use role="status" aria-live regions; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
Do not announce every countdown tick; size buttons expose aria-pressed.
